items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: But you wouldn't work for Lee Bouveau. INTERVIEWEE: No.

ctx.x: I couldn't think that was colored. Lee Bouveau? However, I showed this to this man that was going to manage me -- forgot his name now -- anyway I showed it to him and I tell A.G.V.A. about it. They still think I should have a bond put up.
